category_edits.rationale: Test gentler attenuation of middle-frequency items across all four datasets using normalized training-count features raised to 0.75. Preserve unseen-item zeros, existing attenuation, and checkpoint-backed inference; embeddings, NextItNet topology, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.

response.change_summary: Change the shared training-frequency feature exponent from 0.5 to 0.75. The existing predictor loads the transformed feature buffer from each category's single checkpoint.
